mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in lower cost of capital for corporations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.0% for 2 months), or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate combined with a contraction in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a dual shock of monetary easing and weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in reduced economic growth.
failure_condition: The interaction term is not significant (p>0.05) in regression of 20d returns, or Rank IC for the interaction signal falls below 0.02 over 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100), the market anticipates manufacturing slowdown and reduced corporate output, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger premature monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce household income and consumer spending, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises month-over-month, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) falls below its 12-month moving average, it signals a contraction in consumer spending that reduces corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS < 12-month MA, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 6-month MA, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.02.
